svg.title: What each call read
svg.desc: Seventeen bars, one per model call of the in-line agent, grouped by user turn, each split into tool descriptions (1,594 tokens on every call), base instructions and metadata (about 430), memory blocks (225 to 337) and the conversation with tool calls and results (31 to 1,369). Session 1: one call for the first message, two for the second. Session 2: two calls for each of four messages, each pair an edit and a reply, growing from 2,348 to 3,727 tokens. Session 3: six calls for the question, five searches and the answer, from 2,390 to 3,526 tokens. In all, 47,677 tokens.
svg.text: The in-line agent's 17 model calls for seven user turns. Every call reads the fixed prompt again; a turn with an edit or a
Small labels under a bar: the tool that call made (ins = memory_insert, rep = memory_replace, sea = conversation_search). In all, 47,677 tokens;
the tool descriptions alone are 27,098 of them.
From notebooks/04-letta.ipynb, section 4; parts counted with the model's token counter
